item.title: The Complete Beginner's Guide to Solving Kakuro
item.description: Your first Kakuro grid looks like a crossword someone forgot to finish. Black squares are slashed with diagonal lines, small numbers sit in their corners, and rows of empty white boxes wait for you. You pick the first clue you see, a 15 across three cells, and start trying combinations. 9, 5, 1? 8, 4, 3? 7, 6, 2? Ten minutes later your eraser has worn a shiny patch into the paper and you haven’t committed a single digit.
